The others: (x + 2)²/36 + (y + 1)²/9 = 1 puts 3² under y and 6² under x; (x − 2)²/9 + (y − 1)²/36 = 1 turns the signs of the center; (x − 2)²/36 + (y − 1)²/9 = 1 does both.

The others: (x − 4)²/4 + (y − 4)²/16 = 1 puts 4² under y and 2² under x; (x + 4)²/16 + (y + 4)²/4 = 1 turns the signs of the center; (x + 4)²/4 + (y + 4)²/16 = 1 does both.

The others: (x − 1)²/4 + (y − 1)²/25 = 1 puts 5² under y and 2² under x; (x + 1)²/25 + (y + 1)²/4 = 1 turns the signs of the center; (x + 1)²/4 + (y + 1)²/25 = 1 does both.
